title: Ansel and the Kitchen
author: I. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Voss, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
